notes.top: the first row (from the top) where the state differs from the empty jar: its fill's topmost grain, or for 0 the lowest row the first press changes (the foot's tint and its reflection)
notes.seam: below this row every state built on this one is pixel-identical to it in the PNG masters; a reveal of the next state that starts here never jumps (the next state's band between seam and top covers this state's top surface, as grains landing on it would)
notes.order: f Facebook (a quarter of blue), y YouTube (a quarter of red), i Instagram (a half of one mixed lot of pink and purple), bottom layer first
